title: Northbeam TechWorks Remittance Note: Money Already Held on a Business Invoice
content:
Which payments already received on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job are taken off the charges a business invoice settlement covers is read from the day each payment was recorded.

**Where a payment stands recorded on the job for the day the crew was dispatched**, that payment is treated as held against the charges and taken off them.

**Where payments stand recorded on the job and none of them is for the day the crew was dispatched**, the payments already received are taken off the charges being covered.

**Where neither situation holds**, no payment at all is taken off the charges being covered.

## The readings side by side

| Payments recorded on the job | Taken off the charges being covered |
| --- | --- |
| one or more for the day the crew was dispatched | the payments recorded for that day |
| one or more, none of them for that day | the payments already received, all of them |
| none at all | nothing |

The first reading takes precedence: where a payment for the day the crew was dispatched stands on the job, that is the money treated as held, and payments of other days are not taken off as well.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

**A payment on the dispatch day.** A job carries a payment of 200.00 USD recorded for the day the crew was dispatched and a payment of 80.00 USD recorded on a later day. The first reading governs and 200.00 USD is taken off.

**Payments on other days only.** The same job carries payments of 80.00 USD and 120.00 USD, neither recorded for the day the crew was dispatched. The second reading governs and 200.00 USD, being the payments already received, is taken off.

**No payment at all.** Nothing is taken off the charges being covered.
